items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Well, we used to have a group, we used to jam with Art Tatum.

ctx.x: Who all else, what other musicians, were you likely to be playing with (inaudible)?
Well, we used to have a group, we used to jam with Art Tatum. Stuff Smith and I, we used to go out and jam all the time. We'd stay out all night.
Were you playing horn or were you playing (inaudible)?
